title: A Teen Made This Roblox Game and It Paid for COLLEGE 🚓 #Shorts
content:
Jailbreak was made by badcc and asimo3089 (Badimo) and launched on Roblox in 2017. Prisoners break out and rob banks, jewelry stores and trains while cops chase them. 70,000 people played on day one, it made over a million dollars in its first year, and badcc used the money to pay for Duke University. It hit a record 530,000 players at once in April 2020, has about 7.9 billion visits, and a movie was announced in November 2025.

Cop, or criminal?

title: This Roblox Horror Game Mixed Peppa Pig With Granny 🐷 #Shorts
content:
Piggy was made by MiniToon and uploaded to Roblox in January 2020. It mixes Peppa Pig with the horror game Granny: you escape chapter by chapter while Piggy hunts you. It has been played over 12 billion times. Book 2 arrived in September 2020, and in November 2022 MiniToon said the main game was finished.

title: Subway Surfers Was the FIRST Game to Hit 1 Billion Downloads 🛹 #Shorts
content:
Subway Surfers came out on May 24, 2012, made by Danish studios Kiloo and SYBO. You play Jake, caught spraying graffiti, running from the inspector and his dog. In March 2018 it became the first game on Google Play to reach one billion downloads, passed two billion two months later, and was the most downloaded mobile game every year from 2012 to 2019. Subway Surfers City arrived on February 26, 2026.

title: Roblox Used to Be Called DYNABLOCKS 🧱 #Shorts
content:
Roblox started in 2004 as DynaBlocks, built by David Baszucki and Erik Cassel. It launched on September 1, 2006. Tix were removed in April 2016, guest play ended in October 2017, and since 2008 every game has been made by players. Roblox made 2.29 billion dollars in 2020, went public in March 2021 at a 45 billion dollar valuation, and averaged about 85 million daily players in early 2025.

title: Post Malone Accepted an Award for This Roblox Pet Game 🐶 #Shorts
content:
Pet Simulator 99 launched on December 1, 2023, made by BIG Games, as the sequel to Pet Simulator X. It has over 2,000 pets to hatch and collect. Pet Simulator X hit 1.48 million players at once and won the 2023 Roblox Innovation Award for most concurrent users, which Post Malone accepted for creator Preston. The series also got McDonald's Happy Meal toys in November 2024.

title: Undertale Asked for $5,000. Fans Gave $51,000 ❤️ #Shorts
content:
Undertale's Kickstarter asked for 5,000 dollars in 2013 and raised 51,124 dollars. Toby Fox made the game almost entirely alone, including its music, and released it in 2015. You can finish it without killing anyone, Sans and Papyrus are named after fonts, and it has sold over five million copies.

title: This Roblox Game About BEES Has 3.6 Billion Visits 🐝 #Shorts
content:
Bee Swarm Simulator was made by Onett and went public on Roblox on March 23, 2018. Your bees collect pollen and turn it into honey, and you grow your hive. It reached 100 million visits by June 2018, won Game of the Year at the 2019 Bloxy Awards, became the 19th Roblox game to pass a billion visits in August 2020, and now has over 3.6 billion visits.
